notes.title: 3 Hearts Update!
notes.content:
DEC 13

Added 2 words to ghost in LVL 25 to make the objective more detailed 

Added ghost events to help guide the player

Added one line to a new event to further help the player on what to do in lvl 25

Because of this update, any players who have saved in lvl 25 and did not get out, will actually be stuck in the level and will have to revert back to a save or play the previous version. But because no one actually plays my game or has played my game, the chances are highly unlikely. If you are one of the few who I know have the game, I will give you my backup copy of the previous version so you can continue.

Basically, what I did was make the game a little easier for new players

Gave new attack skill with cool down to a character
Changed frequency up by one to 8 so it can possibly work with magic punches more
Increased this characters hp by 300

Adjusted xenophobic wraith description with more words so the player can better understand what it does.

Change version number to 5

This is possibly the last update for the game!
